mapper.sql: w.id AS id, w.name AS name, w.owner_id AS ownerId, w.source_quota_bytes AS quotaBytes, w.used_source_bytes AS usedSourceBytes, w.reserved_source_bytes AS reservedSourceBytes
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace (id, name, owner_id, source_quota_bytes, used_source_bytes, reserved_source_bytes, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{ownerId}, #{quotaBytes}, 0, 0, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT , (SELECT m.role FROM workspace_member m WHERE m.workspace_id = w.id AND m.user_id = #{userId}) AS role FROM workspace w WHERE w.id = #{workspaceId}
SELECT , m.role AS role FROM workspace w JOIN workspace_member m ON m.workspace_id = w.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.created_at ASC, w.id ASC
SELECT , NULL AS role FROM workspace w WHERE w.id = #{workspaceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE workspace SET reserved_source_bytes = reserved_source_bytes + #{delta}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{workspaceId}
UPDATE workspace SET reserved_source_bytes = GREATEST(0, reserved_source_bytes - #{delta}), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{workspaceId}
UPDATE workspace SET reserved_source_bytes = GREATEST(0, reserved_source_bytes - #{bytes}), used_source_bytes = used_source_bytes + #{bytes}, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{workspaceId}
UPDATE workspace SET used_source_bytes = GREATEST(0, used_source_bytes - #{delta}), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.select: SELECT role FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workspace_member (workspace_id, user_id, role, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{userId}, #{role}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE role = IF(role = 'OWNER', role, VALUES(role)), updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM workspace_member WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND role <> 'OWNER'
mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id AS userId, u.username AS username, m.role AS role FROM workspace_member m JOIN app_user u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY FIELD(m.role, 'OWNER', 'EDITOR', 'VIEWER'), u.username ASC
